title: Evaluate Perplexity and optional SearXNG adapters
description: After cleanup and smoke gates, verify current APIs, auth, cost, citations, constraints, and SSRF/configuration policy. Add only the adapter that provides distinct value; Perplexity first candidate, SearXNG only for explicit self-hosted need. No automatic fallback.

logs.msg: Revalidated official Perplexity Search docs: structured ranked URL/title/snippet/date results, domain/path allow/deny filters, exact publication/update date filters, and recency filters. Revalidated SearXNG JSON API: self-hosted endpoint, engine-dependent time_range, instance format configuration, and query-syntax-dependent site filters. Decision: do not add either now—current public SearchRequest lacks exact date/path fields, Perplexity overlaps shipped domain-capable providers, and SearXNG needs a concrete self-hosted requirement plus endpoint policy. Keep both explicit future candidates; never auto-fallback.
